definitions.full: H5204. niy [ נִי ] noun [masculine] si vera lectio, wailing (AV RV) (= נְהִי ); — קִינָה בְּנִיהֶם אֵלַיִךְ וְנָָֽשְׂאוּ Ezek 27:32 , but improbable; בְּנֵיהֶם ᵑ6 ᵐ5 , see MV; so Co, who, however, strike out as gloss, compare Buhl Berthol. הִי noun [masculine] si vera lectio, wailing (= (נְ)הִי ) q. v.) Ezek 2:10 וָהִ֑י , where probably read וּנְהִי Ol Co, compare Berthol (|| והגה קינים ).
